name: tile
title: Tile
description: Card for a package, a service, a workflow or an agent: media, title, meta, a tag, a body and a footer, in a wrapping grid. The whole card is clickable through one stretched link or button.

a11y.pattern: <article> named by its heading; the heading holds the one link (or toggle button) of the tile, stretched over it with ::after
keyboard: Reaches the title link (or button), then each footer control, tile by tile
Activates a selectable tile's title button, or a footer button
aria: The tile is labelled by its title (aria-labelledby); the grid is a named <section> (or <ul>) with aria-label
Selected: aria-current="true" on the title link, or aria-pressed="true" on the title button
No click handler on the card and no nested interactive elements: footer controls sit beside the title action, above its stretched area
The focus ring of the title action is drawn around the whole tile
Footer buttons repeat the tile name for assistive technology when their word is generic ("Install Open Banking")
a11y.notes: Selection is border, fill and aria state, never colour alone in forced colours (2px Highlight border).
